about: The Haftarah from the Prophets is about Edom, the nation that came from Esau. It ends with the promise that the kingdom will belong to God. The reading from the Apostles tells how Isaac, Jacob and Joseph trusted God’s promises for the future, even at the end of their lives.
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
Did you learn something you need to do in your life?
